##: Codeg is a plain app here, not a WingHarness plugin: its release ships no plugin.json, and with the wingharness- prefix the app would look for that file and refuse the install.
description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other agents.
notes: The NSIS installer is unpacked, not run: Codeg and its web/ export land in the app folder, nothing is registered, and there is no uninstaller to keep.
Sessions, settings and the database live in %APPDATA%\com.anfioo.wingharness\codeg, which WingHarness's own Codeg page reads as well; scoop uninstall leaves that folder alone.
codeg-cli runs one prompt through the running app or a codeg-server; codeg-mcp is the MCP server.
